ideas.pitch: An AI-powered academic copilot that connects Canvas LMS data with LangGraph agents to automate administrative workflows and faculty-student communication.
ideas.title: EduFlow Agentic LMS Integrator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles administrative inefficiencies and fragmented communication in educational institutions by leveraging a proven multi-agent architecture that judges can see working live.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven clinical viva and practical examination simulator for medical and nursing colleges, scoring student responses across a multi-dimensional rubric.
ideas.title: VivaSim Clinical Examiner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high-stakes professional education (medical/nursing schools) where manual examination processes are exceptionally time-consuming and prone to human bias.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent document platform that converts static college syllabus PDFs, lecture notes, and institutional handbooks into interactive semantic knowledge graphs.
ideas.title: SyllabiGraph Knowledge Base
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the limited access to intelligent digital tools for students trying to parse massive amounts of institutional and course documentation.

ideas.pitch: An institutional career and peer-matching mentor platform for universities that integrates real-time curriculum data with personalized skill-gap roadmaps.
ideas.title: UniMentor AI Career Roadmap
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges the gap between academic learning and employability, offering universities a production-ready solution to track student placement readiness.

ideas.pitch: A language acquisition and peer exchange platform for educational institutions built around user-generated short-form video interactions.
ideas.title: LinguaPeer Short-Form Exchange
ideas.why_it_could_win: Offers a highly engaging, consumer-grade UI/UX design that stands out among standard administrative dashboards typically submitted to education hackathons.
